The Prophet frowned and turned away.
Because a blind man came to him and interrupted him.
Allah says: How do you know? Maybe he would become better and cleaner in his heart.
Or he would take a reminder and it would help him.
As for the one who thinks he does not need anything.
You give him your attention.
You are not to blame if he does not become pure.
But as for the one who came to you eager to learn.
And he fears Allah.
You are not paying attention to him.
No! These verses are a reminder.
So whoever wants can remember it.
It is written on honored pages.
High and pure.
In the hands of angel-scribes.
Who are noble and good.
May man be destroyed! How ungrateful he is!
What did Allah create him from?
From a tiny drop He created him and planned out his life.
Then He made the way easy for him.
Then He makes him die and puts him in a grave.
Then when He wants, He will bring him back to life.
No! Man has not done what Allah commanded him.
Let man look at his food.
We poured water down in heavy rain.
Then We split the earth open.
And made grain grow in it.
And grapes and vegetables.
And olives and date palms.
And thick gardens.
And fruit and grass.
All this is for you and your animals to enjoy.
But when the Deafening Blast comes.
On that Day a person will run away from his brother.
And his mother and his father.
And his wife and his children.
Each person that Day will be so busy with his own problem.
Some faces that Day will be shining.
Smiling and happy.
Other faces that Day will be covered with dust.
Darkness will cover them.
Those are the ones who rejected the truth and did wrong.
